findings.input: К поездке ему исполнится восемнадцать. Что ещё нужно уточнить перед изменением состава? Пока ничего не меняй.
findings.actual: Hard user_pause, no pending question, response requires literal continue. Later explicit composition change, budget change and request for a plan remain queued.
findings.attribution: The model mislabeled a question/nonapplication clause as CHANGE+wait. Existing protection for declared ASK/PROPOSE is not proof for this input provenance. Not applying the hypothetical update should not automatically impose a global resume-only barrier unless an explicit pause is requested.
findings.closure: Cached/PG preserves trip for the question, avoids a false hard pause and allows the later explicit change. Genuine user pause still persists and requires explicit resume; no implicit/invented resume. Then fresh actual.

findings.input: Перенеси только выезд на 31 ноября 2026 года.
findings.actual: The model rolled an impossible November31 literal to December1, saved the new date/requested_nights6 and performed five search tools without asking the user to correct the date.
findings.scope: Explicit date-edit intent on an existing trip with no addressed pending slot. A valid model ISO date does not prove fidelity to the invalid literal.
findings.closure: Recognize the impossible current calendar literal, preserve the previous trip and ask for a valid date before source search. Quotes/history/questions remain informational; real explicit valid date edits and ownership stay unchanged. Cached PG plus fresh actual.
